definitions.explanation: A strike or impact that hits a target head-on. Commonly used for natural disasters (typhoons, earthquakes) hitting an area directly, as well as for confronting someone in person (especially in journalism).

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直撃|ちょくげき}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The typhoon made a direct hit on Honshu.

examples.japanese: ⟦レポーター→レポーター：27959_repootaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大臣|だいじん}→大臣：03417_daijin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直撃|ちょくげき}⟦インタビュー→インタビュー：03833_intabyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{円安|えんやす}→円安：04854_enyasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{家計|かけい}→家計：12287_kakei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直撃|ちょくげき}し、⟦{食費|しょくひ}→食費：16477_shokuhi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The weak yen hit household finances directly, and food costs increased significantly.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in news reporting. The pattern ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直撃|ちょくげき} (a typhoon directly strikes ~) is heard frequently during typhoon season. In journalism, {直撃|ちょくげき}⟦インタビュー→インタビュー：03833_intabyuu⟧ or {直撃|ちょくげき}⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧ means confronting someone for an impromptu interview. Also used figuratively for economic impacts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{直撃|ちょくげき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: a typhoon makes a direct hit
- {直撃|ちょくげき}⟦インタビュー→インタビュー：03833_intabyuu⟧: ambush/doorstep interview
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{直撃|ちょくげき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hit the economy directly
- {直撃|ちょくげき}{弾|だん}: a direct hit (projectile)
